base_mesh.shipped_code: none; only data files (base.obj, rig and weight JSON); the GPLv3 add-on code is not shipped or used

edits: Read the g body group of base.obj with a stdlib parser, keeping the file's vertex indices so the MPFB2 weight table applies directly
Scaled 0.1 (MPFB decimetres to metres), rotated from the MPFB frame to the contract frame (Blender Z up, front +Y, anatomical left at -X), scaled by 0.9965 to 1.66 m, feet on the floor (z = 0)

38-joint UE-style contract armature: MPFB2 game-engine joints renamed to the contract names (fingers_01 = middle_01 head, fingers_02 = middle_02 head, twist joints at the parent midpoint, daypack offset 12 cm behind the spine_03 head); rest pose keeps the MPFB2 A-pose and the clips remove 88 percent of its arm splay so the arms hang at the sides

Weights copied from weights.game_engine.json, the four finger chains merged into fingers_01/fingers_02 (thumb_03 into thumb_02), normalised to the top 4 influences, evaluated on the full-resolution mesh before decimation
Decimate collapse to 11000 triangles, then split into VIS_body and VIS_head by dominant bone (head/neck_01), one triangle-free primitive each
Flat vertex colours, no textures: #1f2a44 coat (torso, arms), #a8a59a trousers (thighs, calves), #2a2622 shoes, #c99a7a skin (hands, face), #3b2a20 bob hair, #6f6457 tote
Tote joined into the body as a 0.30 x 0.08 x 0.28 m box at the right hip, weighted 1.0 to the pelvis
VIS_head shape keys Basis, blinkLeft, blinkRight; each blink lowers the upper-lid vertices within 1.5 cm of its eye centre by 6 mm (4 left, 5 right vertices)

Clips idle (4.0 s), walk (1.0 s), run (0.6 s) at 30 fps, in place, last frame equal to the first; legs driven by planar two-link IK onto ankle targets, feet kept flat in stance, pelvis bob 2 cm at stride frequency, arms adducted with walk swing +/-15 deg and run swing +/-30 deg plus ~70 deg elbow bend opposite the legs
